definitions.explanation: A hairstyle in which the hair is gathered and tied at the back of the head so that it hangs down like a pony's tail. One of the most common hairstyles referred to in everyday Japanese.

examples.japanese: ポニーテール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'll put my hair in a ponytail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧ポニーテールにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She always wears her hair in a ponytail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ポニーテール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結|むす}んだ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
examples.english: It was hot, so I tied my hair up in a ponytail.

notes:
A loanword from English. One of the most commonly mentioned hairstyle names in everyday conversation. The pattern ポニーテール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means 'to put one's hair in a ponytail.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ポニーテール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put one's hair in a ponytail
- ポニーテール⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to tie one's hair in a ponytail
- ⟦{高|たか}め→高め：14861_takame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ポニーテール: high ponytail
- ⟦{低|ひく}め→低め：24497_hikume⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ポニーテール: low ponytail

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦おさげ→おさげ：20771_osage⟧: braids, pigtails — hair divided and tied on both sides
- お⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧: hair bun — hair twisted and pinned up
- ツインテール: twin tails — two ponytails, one on each side
- ⟦{三|み}つ{編|あ}み→三つ編み：18439_mitsuami⟧: braid — hair woven in three strands
